properties.name: Downtown Loop
properties.notes: Primary downtown hub (Loop / central business district). Prospective central interchange for all regional spokes.

properties.name: O'Hare International (ORD)
properties.notes: Airport terminus — northwest spoke. High peak air-rail transfer demand.

properties.name: Midway International (MDW)
properties.notes: Southwest-side airport hub linking downtown, Joliet, and South Shore corridors.

properties.name: Oakbrook Center
properties.notes: West-suburban retail / employment node (Oak Brook). Intermediate toward Naperville.

properties.name: Naperville
properties.notes: Major western suburban employment and residential hub.

properties.name: Woodfield Mall
properties.notes: Schaumburg regional retail / NW suburban interchange; links toward O'Hare.

properties.name: South Shore Border Hub
properties.notes: Prospective south-east metro hub near the Illinois–Indiana border (South Shore / Calumet corridor), positioned for cross-border and Michigan City–direction growth.

properties.name: Joliet
properties.notes: Southwest suburban hub — balances network coverage with industrial and residential catchments along I-55 / Des Plaines corridor.
